name: Johansson trucker cap

purpose.for: Islanders who work bare-headed under the Okinawan sun on the quay and the boats and want a good cap, not a giveaway: Kōji at the catch tables first, Riku watching the boats come in from the quay wall, Mr Fujita on the bridge wing.
purpose.why: A peak against the glare off the water, a mesh back that lets the sea wind through, a strap that fits anyone; made as well as an imported cap, by the town's own maker, with Johansson's J raised on the front.
purpose.where: On the cap tree at Sakura Shōten by the east window, beside the till and in the window, a stack on each cap form; and on the heads of whoever bought one (src/avatars/hat-assets.js fits it to any head).

notes: Johansson Headwear's JH-712, a late-1990s six-panel trucker made as a premium one is, built in Blender from a script (site: johansson-town/assets/catalog/johansson-trucker/source/build-johansson-trucker.py, with the .blend and the weave tile). Its J is the house mark: a heavy round-ended J inside the double ring of the site's rubber-stamp seal (config.js CONFIG.logo), raised embroidery with a gold satin outline. Real trucker measurements (58 cm band, a 12 cm foam front, a 7 cm bill, 4.5 mm knit) scaled to the town's default adult head; World fits it to any other head from the model's extras (wear). Materials: front (the wearer's hatColour), mesh (see-through, the accent), accent (undervisor, piping, rope, J: the accent), trim (fixed). Replaces the Seagulls six-panel for now (the creator, 2026-10-14), whose source is kept in source/seagulls-six-panel/.
